## 说明

该函数读取用`download_fao_data()`下载的某个版本，或包自带的数据。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

This function loads a release downloaded with `download_fao_data()`, or the
data bundled with the package.

</details>

## 用法

```r
load_fao_data(version = "latest", data_dir = fao_data_dir())
```

## 参数

`version`
:   要读取的版本，如"2026.1.0"。默认为"latest"，即已下载的各版本与包自带数据中最新的一个。使用"bundled"读取包自带的数据。指定的版本尚未下载时会报错。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The release to load, e.g. "2026.1.0". Default is "latest", the
    newest of the downloaded releases and the bundled data. Use "bundled" for the
    data bundled with the package.

    </details>

`data_dir`
:   下载的数据版本的保存目录。默认为`fao_data_dir()`。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The directory where downloaded releases are stored. Default is `fao_data_dir()`.

    </details>

## 返回值

一个数据框，其列与`Global_Production_long`相同。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

A data frame with the columns of `Global_Production_long`.

</details>

## 另请参阅

Other FAO data:
`check_fao_update()`,
`download_fao_data()`,
`fao_data_dir()`,
`fao_data_info()`

## 示例

```r
data <- load_fao_data()
FAO27 <- subset(data, FAO.major.fishing.area..Name. == "Atlantic, Northeast")
```
